description: A50: POST /auth/reset-password as the app sends it. reset_token is the spec's field name and carries the 6-digit code (leading zeros kept). 204 with no body on success: every session of the account is revoked and no token is returned. A wrong, expired, used or exhausted code, or an unknown email, is the same invalid_code answer; password rules are registration's (12 characters, confirmed, not known-breached).

reset_token: This code is not valid. Request a new one.

password: The password field must be at least 12 characters.
